articles.notes: The useful design contrast is transparent FUSE compatibility versus USRBIO’s shared-memory request/data path. ior holds I/O metadata, iov holds data; the daemon owns RDMA registration and most control logic. Claimed sequential-write improvement is workload-specific, not independently reproduced.
